description:
An assembly (a STEP export from SolidWorks, Fusion, Onshape, Inventor...) split into its parts: each distinct
    part once with how many the assembly uses, the stock part its name says it is (a Toolbox screw, a bearing by number
    or size) with the words it was read from, each other part as its own uploaded STEP file, and Cliff's check of it as
    milled, turned, sheet and printed (can it, what blocks it, Cliff's estimate). `bom_lines` go to price_bom once you
    add each made line's process and material (choose from its `processes`; ask the person when the material matters).
    Read once and kept. Needs an API key.
name: decompose_file
